<!--
Journal mode sets its own page: three quarters of an inch at the sides and
the top, an inch at the foot, with the running head inside the top margin.
In the .pdf that page used to be written over whatever the document asked
for. Now the document's margin comes after it and wins, and the head and
foot settings it does not mention stay. typst always let the document's
margin win; this checks it is still handed over.
